desc: 蜜桃拱门礼盒首屏开场，可动机械臂与手柄遥控双证明，沙滩客厅收口
leaf: 迷你卡通遥控工程挖掘机玩具（黄车身灰车顶黑胎黄毂，可左右旋转的可动机械臂配齿纹铲斗，随附一枚手持遥控手柄）
name: 迷你卡通遥控挖掘机玩具款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼看清这是一台可动臂迷你遥控工程车而不是普通惯性小车，靠干净剪影拿点击并满足白底主图合规。
详情页首屏承接主图点击，用暖桃拱门礼盒舞台加一行大字，一秒给出送礼这一第一购买理由。
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 across the top field in #2D2D2D, one support line 「{callout_1}」 directly beneath it in #DE9E82

shots.intent: 用左编号右三卡的三行结构把驾驶室、可左右旋转的机械臂与可升降铲斗三处可见机构一次讲清，回答怎么玩。
shots.textZone: heading in the top band, one number badge plus one short heading and one support line per left-hand row

shots.intent: 把随附手柄与车辆放进同一画面，用低角度操作瞬间证明它是遥控玩的，而不是推一下走一下。
shots.textZone: one short lower-left label 「{callout_3}」 at 14pt in #2D2D2D sitting on a flat #FFFFFF band

shots.intent: 同一台车两种状态的等距等光对比，把只能摆着看和臂斗真的在动这一差别直接给眼睛看，而不是靠话术。
shots.textZone: one short top-centre label 「{selling_point_3}」 in #2D2D2D plus two small contrast chips 「{callout_4}」 and 「{callout_5}」 at the panel bottoms

shots.intent: 微距交代转销、合模线与铲斗齿纹，把做工证明交给画面本身，替代空洞的匠心话术。
shots.textZone: one small rounded accent badge in the lower corner holding a single short label

shots.intent: 把车放进真实沙地，用低角度与压出的胎印做尺度参照，让家长代入孩子在户外挖沙的画面。
shots.textZone: one short lower-left label 「{callout_7}」 at 14pt in #2D2D2D on a flat #FFFFFF band

shots.intent: 把车放进真实的客厅亲子时刻，让买家把自己代入陪玩的一方，完成情感认同这一步。
shots.textZone: one short upper-centre label 「{selling_point_4}」 at 20pt in #2D2D2D on a flat #FFFFFF band

shots.intent: 正俯视一次摊开到货实物与规格占位栏，用可见清单去掉风险，数值与资质全部留给卖家自填而不编造。
shots.textZone: one dashed #DE9E82 keyline label box at the right carrying a heading and four short spec rows

shots.intent: 详情页最后一屏收口，把首屏的拱门礼盒舞台回收成送礼理由加一个明确按钮，将看完的犹豫转成加购。
shots.textZone: heading and one support line inside the arch panel, rounded CTA button below them

style.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF paper sweeps for the packshot, the comparison panels and the flat lay; a warm #F7DCCD studio stage carrying one #DE9E82 arch niche with flat #FFFFFF stylised cloud shapes for the gift hero and the closing screen; infographic screens on flat #F7DCCD fields with every feature photo inside a rounded #FFFFFF card; a real sand field is allowed only on the single outdoor screen; never a random stock interior behind an infographic
style.direction: warm peach gift-stage kids remote-control toy ecommerce, arch-niche studio set mixed with clean rounded infographic cards
style.iconSystem: single-weight #2D2D2D thin-line glyph centred inside one flat #F7DCCD disc ringed with a thin #DE9E82 line, one icon per feature row, plus small solid #F5C511 numbered circle badges with hairline leader lines; no filled emblems, no certificate artwork, no seals, no QR codes
style.lightingSystem: 5200K warm soft key from the upper left with a thin bounce fill on the shadow side, controlled specular on the glossy moulded body and on the grey cab block, true contact shadow under all four tyres, no blown highlights; the outdoor screen uses 5500K natural sun from camera right with every shadow falling consistently to the left; the indoor lifestyle screen uses 4800K window light from camera left
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm peach gift-stage kids remote-control toy ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #FFFFFF base field, #F7DCCD stage field and #DE9E82 arch plus button colour, #2D2D2D text ink and one #F5C511 engineering-yellow accent reserved for the product and the numbered badges; warm tone throughout; one rounded modern geometric sans-serif family with heavy 28-40pt headlines, 14-18pt support lines and 10-14pt labels, all rendered copy carried only as short 「」 placeholders; background system of seamless #FFFFFF sweeps for packshots and flat lays, a #F7DCCD stage carrying one #DE9E82 arch niche with flat #FFFFFF cloud shapes on the gift hero and closing screen, infographic screens on flat #F7DCCD fields with each feature photo inside a rounded #FFFFFF card, a real sand field on the single outdoor screen only; lighting system of a 5200K warm soft key from the upper left with a thin bounce fill, controlled specular on the glossy moulded body and a true contact shadow under every tyre, the outdoor screen in 5500K sun from camera right; layout system of rounded 24px photo cards, one thin-line glyph in a #F7DCCD disc ringed in #DE9E82 per feature row, small solid #F5C511 numbered circles with hairline leader lines and one dashed #DE9E82 keyline label box on the closing screens; icon system of single-weight #2D2D2D thin-line glyphs in flat #F7DCCD discs, no emblems, no certificate artwork, no QR codes; product always rendered true to the reference at a stable front 3/4 attitude, consistent scale, all four tyres grounded and never floating without a contact shadow; noDrift: no colour palette changes and no new accent colours beyond #F5C511
no mixed fonts, no brush, handwritten or cartoon display lettering
no random backgrounds and no stock-photo interiors on infographic screens
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing tyre contact shadows
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge or certificate artwork
no identifiable faces and no likeness of any real child or adult

style.presentationRules: body colour, cab-roof colour, hub colour, tyre colour, boom geometry and the raised-boom proportion come only from the reference image and never shift between screens; the vehicle keeps the same scale and the same front 3/4 attitude across the set with all four tyres grounded and a real contact shadow, never floating; at least one overhead and one low camera per set; any person appears faceless and generic or is cropped out entirely; no invented mechanism beyond what the reference shows
style.surfaceSystem: a #F3E7DE matte podium with one clear riser edged by a thin #D9A62E line as the gift-stage surface, pale #F3EEE6 matte board inside infographic cards, fine #D9BE94 dry sand with a #C9A97F damp band as the only outdoor ground, pale #EFE7E1 floor plus a soft light rug in the indoor scene
style.typography: one rounded modern geometric sans-serif family across Chinese and Latin; heavy 28-40pt headlines in #2D2D2D on light fields or #FFFFFF on #DE9E82, 14-18pt support lines, 10-14pt labels; all rendered copy is short 「{selling_point_N}」 and 「{callout_N}」 placeholders, per-screen budget under 45 characters
